title: Food specially processed to reduce gluten content to a level 20–100 mg/kg

official_sources.title: Food Products Standards & Food Additives Compendium — current chapter index

operative_status.omitted_by: Notification F. No. 1-116/Scientific Committee/Notif.27/2010-FSSAI(E) dated 04.03.2021 (Amendment no. 73)
operative_status.engine_rule: Never offer the former 20–100 mg/kg specially processed gluten route as a current compliance option.

historical_text_summary: The former provision covered food specially processed to reduce gluten content to 20–100 mg/kg. It is retained only for regulatory history and must not be used as an active route.
